scores.tell: Dock posts have a bit too uniform soft orange sheen; water caustics busy, but form turn and soft contact shadows fit.
Dome and door lit with soft broad sheen and gentle shadow depth; only slightly uniform glossy glass highlights.
Dock planks and posts are smooth and lit evenly with little shadow depth; the dock casts almost no shadow on the water.
Pumpkin has smooth form turn and a soft cast shadow, with a slightly airbrushed, glowy sheen on the ribs.
Black locomotive has sharp gloss streaks and hot spots on the boiler, and its shadows are dark and hard, which makes it look more like 3D plastic.
Near-identical to c214: glossy black boiler streaks and crisp specular edges; shading is a little more rendered than the real cards.
Rope has a soft, broad sheen and gentle form turn in the same style as the real towel; none worth noting.
The UFO dome has sharp white hot spots, the teal disc is a flat gradient, and there is no cast or contact shadow, so it looks airbrushed and floats.
Tombstone has flat gray-blue faces with almost no form turn or highlights, and a hard cast shadow, so it looks like clay-matte vector.
Marble table and stools have soft, even shading and gentle cast shadows; the form turn is a bit flat and the bounce from the grass is faint.
